title: Phantom Blade Zero Boss Drops - Every Weapon and Where It Comes From
description: What each of Phantom Blade Zero's 37 dropping bosses gives you, with the boss page linked both ways so you can work from the weapon or the fight. Bosses with no recorded drop are listed too, rather than left out.
keyword: phantom blade zero boss drops, boss rewards, weapon drops

sections.title: Bosses Drop Their Own Weapon
sections.content:
Phantom Blade Zero follows one rule almost without exception: the boss you just beat was using the weapon it hands you. Bi Feng gives up the Juggernaut, Cavalrybane gives up Armybreaker, Peng Meng gives up the Dread Axe.

That makes the drop table a weapon acquisition list in disguise, and it explains why the fastest route to a specific build is a specific fight rather than a specific shop. The item-first view is the weapons hub; this page is the fight-first view.
